svg.title: Integrated crop-care handoff workflow
svg.desc: A handoff workflow combining propagation, canopy, and IPM evidence into identity, task status, observations, biosecurity actions, authorized actions, unresolved conditions, escalation, and next action.
svg.text: Integrated crop-care handoff: preserve what is still open

g.text: Receiving role must be able to reconstruct:
• Identity — room, zone, donor, lot, tray, plant or work order
• Task status — complete, partial, held, or not started
• Evidence — what was actually observed or measured
• Biosecurity — sanitation, isolation, quarantine, movement restriction
• Authorized action, escalation, unresolved condition, and next action
Do not convert uncertainty into a guessed diagnosis, identity, release decision, or treatment simply to make the record look complete.
